summary.one_liner: Catch is a macOS menubar app that automatically downloads new episodes from RSS, Atom, and ShowRSS feeds as they are released.
summary.what_it_does: Catch runs in the Mac menubar and monitors feeds you add. It accepts any number of RSS and Atom feeds, with special support for ShowRSS feeds. Matching items are handed off to a BitTorrent client or a custom script for download. You can limit Catch to active hours of the day. Notification Center notifications are optional. The README says the app supports Big Sur, Dark Mode, and Apple Silicon, and is localized into 11 languages.
use_cases: broadcatch podcasts or shows from RSS feeds
track ShowRSS torrent feeds on a Mac
schedule downloads to run only at certain hours
hand off feed items to a BitTorrent client
notable: Menubar app that stays light on resources
Can run a custom script on matched items instead of a BitTorrent client
caveats: README gives no installation commands; download is via a 'Download Now' link
Feed matching details and setup are not described in the README
